s01.h1: Sell Every Phase From One Model, Concept to Handover
s01.subheadingBodyCopy: We support developers at every project stage: turning concepts into off-plan digital twins, capturing Matterport tours of model units, and bringing every 3D asset into one web platform for unbuilt and completed stock.

s02.h2: Keep Sales Moving Through Every Development Stage
s02.subheadingBodyCopy: Master developments roll out over years of phases. Manzili keeps your 3D assets in use the whole way, from off-plan digital twins to model-unit scans and completed-stock sales.
s02.block01Body: We turn CAD, BIM and GIS data into interactive Unreal Engine 5 environments from the concept stage onward. Developers present high-fidelity masterplans on gallery touch tables and share lightweight web versions with buyers anywhere.
block01Features: Showroom hardware and mobile web in sync
s02.block02Body: As show villas and mock-up units are completed, our technicians scan them with Matterport Pro3 cameras. The tours sit inside the web platform, so remote buyers can inspect real finishes and layouts next to the off-plan twin.
s02.block03Body: Support continues past handover into secondary inventory and completed commercial assets. We capture Matterport tours of finished towers, offices and retail districts, so asset teams can sign tenants and buyers faster.
block03Features: Accurate digital record for facility handover

s03.subheadingBodyCopy: See how Matterport scans sit inside the developer web platform, so remote buyers can inspect model units and completed properties in accurate 3D.
s03.card01Body: LiDAR scan capturing proportions, bespoke joinery and natural courtyard light.
s03.card02Tag: Completed Unit · Ready to Move In
s03.card02Body: Full interior and terrace scan, with panoramic city orientation and accurate floor layouts.

s04.h2: Value Across the Full Development Cycle
s04.card01Body: The master model is updated as plans change, so you avoid costly re-renders and your gallery always matches construction progress.
s04.card02Body: Matterport tours put your show villas in front of GCC and international buyers online, so you get more return on the cost of building them.
s04.card03Body: Manage off-plan towers, model units and completed stock from one web interface.

s05.q1: How do Matterport tours integrate into the web platform?
s05.a1: The scans are embedded in your project's web platform. From the interactive floor plan, buyers and consultants switch between the off-plan 3D model and the scan of the built model unit.
s05.q2: Can Manzili capture 3D tours for ready-built completed projects?
s05.a2: Yes. Our technicians scan completed units with Matterport Pro3 cameras, and the tours sit in the same web platform as the off-plan twin.
s05.q3: What happens when architectural designs or phase layouts change?
s05.a3: Changes go into the single master model and publish to the showroom app and web platform together, so both always show the same plans.
